# OSM Beta Dataset — I-65 West Lafayette to Indianapolis

Real highway stops (gas stations, rest areas, travel centres/services) along
I-65 between West Lafayette and Indianapolis, Indiana. Built for HerStop's beta
corridor per the founder's bbox decision: `39.80,-87.00,40.47,-86.10`.

**Generated by code, repeatable.** As of 2026-09-22 this dataset is produced by
`apps/mobile/scripts/ingest-osm-stops.mjs` — re-run it to refresh with current
OSM data, instead of hand-editing these files. The corresponding SQL is
generated alongside it at `docs/migrations/006_ingest_real_stops.sql`.
The original 2026-09-15 dataset here (18 stops) was hand-curated by an agent
session, not code — see git history for that version. The current version
keeps every deduplicated, named, addressable, operational stop the script
finds in the corridor (44 as of the last run) rather than a subjective
18-of-42 selection, so the pipeline needs no manual curation step to re-run.

**Source:** [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) contributors, via
the Overpass API and Nominatim reverse geocoding. Full query and processing
steps are in `provenance.json` (regenerated on every run, includes the
retrieval timestamp of the current data).

**Licence:** Data is © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the
[Open Database License (ODbL)](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/).
Any product surface using this data must carry the attribution:
**"© OpenStreetMap contributors"**.

**No fabricated fields.** Every value in `beta-stops.json` came directly from an
OSM tag or a Nominatim response field — nothing was inferred or guessed. A field
left null/empty (e.g. no `toilets` tag, no rest-area-equivalent app category)
means it wasn't available, not that it was guessed.

**Lebanon Rest Area excluded.** `osm-way-229125508` ("Lebanon Rest Area - I65
SB") is excluded — tagged `landuse=construction` (still true as of the last
run) and `toilets=no` in OSM, so not a usable stop. The script filters this
generally (any `landuse=construction` or `construction=*` tagged feature),
not as a one-off hardcoded exclusion, so a similar not-yet-open feature
elsewhere is excluded automatically too.

See `provenance.json` for the exact Overpass query and dedup logic.
